notes: One unit: cases that roll out as one. Cases that live stacked in the shop (a rack on a rack) can be made one unit for a load: ⌘-click them in the truck, then Load › Make Them One Unit (⌘G). They share one load number, go in together, get one pack label naming each case, and pick, drag and turn as one. Send gives each the same number, so one scan in ShopCall brings up the whole unit. It belongs to the load only (the library doesn't change); Split the Unit (⇧⌘G) takes it apart. Long contents stop at the “…” on Avery labels. A case holding more than four lines’ worth printed a fifth line under…
